description: Center check-in/check-out UI and independent doctor registration flow. Adds check-in/check-out action buttons to center bookings page, displays commission details after checkout, and creates new doctor signup page at /signup/doctor. Depends on FEAT-002 (APIs) for check-in/out and doctor registration endpoints.
steps: Update app/center/bookings/page.tsx: add checkedInAt, checkedOutAt, commissionAmount, centerEarnings to Booking interface
Fetch bookings with check-in/out fields: existing GET /api/bookings already returns all fields
Add handleCheckin function: POST to /api/center/checkin with { bookingId }, update local state with returned booking including checkedInAt timestamp

Add handleCheckout function: POST to /api/center/checkout with { bookingId }, update local state with returned booking including commissionAmount and centerEarnings, show success toast with commission details

Modify booking card/row rendering: for CONFIRMED bookings without checkedInAt, show 'Check In' button (green); for bookings with checkedInAt but no checkedOutAt, show 'Checked In' badge and 'Check Out' button (blue); for COMPLETED bookings, show 'Completed' badge and display commission details
Add conditional commission info display: if booking.commissionAmount exists, show 'Commission: ${commissionAmount}' and 'Center Earnings: ${centerEarnings}' in small text below booking details
Create app/signup/doctor/page.tsx: new doctor registration page

Implement two-step doctor signup form: Step 1 - account creation (email, password, name, phone) using Better Auth signup, Step 2 - doctor profile (specialization dropdown, license number, consultation fee, bio textarea, optional image upload)
Fetch doctor specializations for dropdown: GET from a new endpoint /api/specializations or query doctor_specializations table directly in component useEffect

Implement form submission: create user account with role='DOCTOR', then POST to /api/doctors/register with profile details, show success message 'Registration submitted. Pending admin approval.', redirect to /doctor/dashboard or pending page
Style signup page following existing pattern in app/signup/patient/page.tsx or app/signup/center/page.tsx: two-column layout or single form with sections, Tailwind classes, dark mode support
Add link to doctor signup from main signup page or login page: 'Register as Doctor' link pointing to /signup/doctor
Test check-in/out flow: create booking, confirm it, check in via UI, verify timestamp displayed, check out, verify status changes to COMPLETED and commission displays correctly
Test doctor registration: fill form at /signup/doctor, submit, verify user created with role=DOCTOR and doctor profile created with is_independent=true
acceptance_criteria: npm run build compiles with no errors
Center bookings page displays 'Check In' button for CONFIRMED bookings not yet checked in
Clicking 'Check In' updates booking and shows 'Checked In' badge with timestamp
'Check Out' button appears only for checked-in bookings (has checkedInAt, no checkedOutAt)
Clicking 'Check Out' marks booking as COMPLETED and displays commission information
Commission details (amount and center earnings) are visible after checkout to center users
Doctor signup page at /signup/doctor renders with account and profile sections
Specialization dropdown populates with options from doctor_specializations table
Submitting doctor signup form creates user with role=DOCTOR and doctor profile with userId set, centerId=null, isIndependent=true
After signup, user sees confirmation message and is redirected appropriately
UI is consistent with existing design patterns: Tailwind classes, colors, spacing, responsive layout
verification: Run npm run build and verify exit code 0
Start dev server: npm run dev
Login as center user, navigate to /center/bookings
Find a CONFIRMED booking, click 'Check In' button; verify UI updates to show 'Checked In' badge and check-out button appears
Click 'Check Out' button; verify booking row updates to show COMPLETED status and commission details display
Query database: SELECT status, checked_in_at, checked_out_at, commission_amount, center_earnings FROM bookings WHERE id='booking-id'; verify all fields populated
Fill out form with test data: email=test-doctor@example.com, password, name, specialization=Cardiology, licenseNumber=MD-12345, consultationFee=150
Submit form; verify success message appears
Query users table: SELECT id, email, role FROM users WHERE email='test-doctor@example.com'; expect role=DOCTOR

Query doctors table: SELECT user_id, center_id, is_independent, active FROM doctors WHERE user_id=(SELECT id FROM users WHERE email='test-doctor@example.com'); expect center_id=null, is_independent=true, active=false
